verdict.rationale: The evidence shows searchable transcripts of past meetings, notes that store attendee emails, action-item listing APIs, and an MCP server for asking questions about meetings. Nothing documents Fellow proactively surfacing prior meetings with the same attendees, or generating a brief of open threads before a call. These items are on-demand search, developer building blocks, or external-assistant queries, which are adjacent and earn no credit for an automatic pre-meeting brief.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
